package.name: cobot_vision
package.description: Vision pipeline, split into two nodes: yolo_node — pure perception: YOLO-OBB on the latest color frame, publishes pixel-space detections. Only importer of ultralytics (pip dependency, no rosdep key). localization_node — pure geometry: homography px→mm, rz from corners, real_z measured from the depth stream, snake pick ordering. Also serves the cheap tier-1 depth checks (VerifyTarget, GetLayerHeight). train_yolo_obb.py is an offline tool, not a node.
